requirements.requirement: The system must accept structured user condition intent and trial condition inputs defined by the REL-001 schema.
The system must perform exact string matching between user condition and trial conditions and assign the highest match weight when identical.
The system must perform partial matching (substring or token overlap) and assign a lower weight than exact matches.
The system must support synonym-based matching using normalized or mapped condition terms when available in structured inputs.
The system must compute embedding-based similarity between user condition intent and trial conditions using embedding_client.py.
The system must combine structured matching scores and embedding similarity into a single normalized relevance score between 0 and 1.
The system must produce explanation factors indicating which matching methods contributed to the final score (exact, partial, synonym, embedding).
The system must prioritize exact matches over all other match types in the final scoring aggregation.
The system must ensure deterministic scoring such that identical inputs always produce identical relevance scores.
The system must handle multiple trial conditions by aggregating the best or combined match against the user condition intent.
The system must return a relevance score of 0 when no structured or embedding similarity exceeds a minimum threshold.
The system must generate explanation factors that are human-readable and mapped to the computed scoring components.
The system must gracefully fallback to structured matching only if the embedding service is unavailable.
The system must return a valid response with score and empty explanation factors if input conditions are present but no matches are found.
